note: What each sound file is and the words it was made from. `node scripts/make-sounds.mjs` makes the missing ones with ElevenLabs (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY); `--force id` makes one again. Files land in public/audio/<id>.mp3.

sounds.text: A small cartoon frog hop: a soft bouncy boing followed by a tiny water plip. Cute, gentle, quiet, no voice, no music.
A single soft kalimba note plucked once, warm and round, clearly audible, recorded close, then it fades quickly. No background, no voice.
A warm soft pad chord swelling gently and fading, cozy and comforting, like a quiet hug. No melody, no voice.
A short happy reward jingle: three clear rising kalimba notes, then a soft sparkle. Bright but gentle, clearly audible, cozy mobile game style, no voice.
A warm gentle success chime: two clear soft marimba notes rising one after the other, then a small shimmer that fades. Calm, cozy and reassuring, clearly audible, no voice.
A handful of small dry leaves rustling softly as they land, followed by one gentle glassy chime note. Clearly audible, pleasant, recorded close.
One soft low warm bell tone that fades slowly, calming, like a slow deep breath. No melody.
A paper notebook page being turned once: a soft crisp paper rustle, clearly audible, recorded close, no background.
A lily pad leaf gently set down on calm pond water: a soft plop and tiny ripples. Close, quiet, no background.
A small frog slipping into a calm pond: one soft gentle water splash, close, quiet, no background.
One gentle swim stroke in calm water, a soft short swish, quiet, no background.
One small soft thump of a little animal landing on grass: a short muffled thud with a faint grass rustle. Clearly audible, recorded close, no background.
A single small frog croak, one short ribbit, close and clean, no background, no other animals.
A small tree frog calling twice, two short soft croaks, close and clean, no background.
A tiny young frog making one short high gentle peep-like croak, cute, close and clean, no background.

Night pond ambience recorded close: water lapping gently at the bank, reeds moving in a light breeze, frogs croaking at an easy pace, crickets. Clearly audible and steady, peaceful, no people, no music, no sudden sounds.

Calm, warm, cozy instrumental for resting beside a small quiet pond in early spring. Slow tempo around 70 BPM. Soft felt piano, gentle kalimba and marimba, a warm pad, a few acoustic guitar harmonics. No drums, no percussion hits, no vocals. Peaceful, safe and unhurried, a simple tender repeating motif that can loop without a big ending. Soft dynamics throughout, nothing sudden.

A gentle, friendly instrumental for a little frog village around a pond. Light pizzicato strings, ukulele, soft marimba and a wooden guiro that sounds a little like frogs croaking. Slow bouncy rhythm around 88 BPM, cozy and playful but calm, no heavy drums, no vocals. A simple cheerful repeating motif that can loop without a big ending. Soft dynamics throughout, nothing sudden.
